retrievalProfile.description: A centered, framed surrealist illustration featuring a silhouette filled with sky and nature motifs against a vast white field.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central rectangular frame containing a silhouette of a head filled with a blue sky, clouds, and a rainbow. The silhouette is surrounded by detailed nature elements like butterflies, lilies, and birds, all set against a stark white background with centered serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Central framed illustration against a wide white margin
Symmetrical placement of text above and below the frame
Organic nature elements overlapping the base of the silhouette
coreInvariants: Thin double-line rectangular border around the central art
Sky-filled silhouette as the primary focal point
Soft, stippled or pencil-textured rendering style

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The main illustration is centered, occupying approximately 40% of the total canvas area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The sky-filled silhouette within the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top text, move down into the framed illustration, follow the rainbow curve, and land on the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space surrounding the central frame creates a sense of airy isolation.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high value palette with soft, faded transitions.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand is stylized with a fluid, calligraphic loop
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for both artist and title to maintain classical balance.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classical proportions and bracketed serifs.
Provides the necessary elegance and stroke contrast.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a centered rectangular frame with a thin double-line border on a white background. Inside the frame, place a surrealist silhouette of a head filled with a blue sky, white clouds, and a vertical rainbow. Surround the base of the silhouette with a large yellow butterfly, white lilies, and a small red insect. Add two birds flying in the sky area.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered text in a light-weight Old Style Serif font at the top and bottom of the canvas, using all caps and wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the text centered and all-caps?
Is there a thin double-line border around the art?
Does the silhouette contain a sky and rainbow?

mustRedesign: Do not use specific artist names
Do not use specific album titles
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the frame is perfectly centered.
Check that the typography does not touch the frame.
Verify the texture looks like colored pencil or watercolor.
Confirm the white space is dominant.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a centered surrealist framed illustration with wide-tracked serif typography on a minimalist white field.
